scope: Store-wide rule for all promotion-generated monetary amounts in current mobile and desktop designs, sections 30–34
discount: Round each applicable discount up to whole RUB, limited by eligible remaining base and seller maximum discount
sequence: Compute following discounts from the already rounded remaining price, then sum exact components for payable total
cashbackEarning: If earning is selected, round credited earning up to whole RUB
cashbackSpending: Floor permitted maximum to whole RUB, bounded by available balance and configured percentage; only integer RUB input
wallet: Wallet payments are payment sources. Do not round away existing balances or refunds. They do not create an additional discount.
implementationStatus: Figma and design handoff updated only. Production pricing requires a coordinated frontend/backend implementation, not a display formatter.
